title: Rapid Prototyping with AI
summary: CT390, a 15-week course where students from different disciplines learn to build and ship web apps with AI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex.
responsibilities: Designed four projects that build on each other: a static site from a Figma design using MCP, an AI chat app with tool calls, an animated midterm app tested for accessibility, and a multiplayer team chat app with Google sign-in.
Built the course website and reference apps in Next.js.
Run assignments and submissions through Classroom 50.
features: Figma-to-code with the Figma MCP server
Real-time multiplayer chat on Cloudflare Workers
